units.title: Kienzle correction factor tables (Kγ/Kver/Kvb/Ksch/Kkühl)
units.scope: Per ISO group: Kγ_ref_deg + Kγ_slope (Victor 1957); Kver_VB_table (wear progression); Kvb_BUE_band; Ksch_chipbreaker_lookup; Kkühl_dry_wet_mql.

units.title: Johnson-Cook constitutive table per material
units.scope: (A, B, n, C, eps_dot_0, m, T_melt, T_room) for steel (Lesuer LLNL), Ti-6Al-4V (Lee-Lin), Inconel 718 (Erice), Al 7075, Mg AZ31, etc. Sourced + cited.

units.title: Multi-mode FRF schema (frf_modes[] not single-lobe SLD)
units.scope: frf_modes: Array<{f_n, zeta, k_modal}> in sidecar; required for slender boring bars, long-stickout endmills.

units.title: BUE regime guard + process damping (PPG-MS14 predicate #10)
units.scope: CANONICAL_BUE_REGIME (Vc_min/max per ISO group); inhibit Kienzle extrapolation in BUE band; process damping below Vc threshold (Tunc-Budak 2012) — guard SLD lookup.

units.title: σ + (μ, σ, n_obs, last_updated) per material constant
units.scope: Replace point-estimate kc1.1/Taylor C with statistical tuple; propagate σ to MS9 drift canary so '2σ' threshold is computable; Bayesian prior precision explicit.

units.title: Loewen-Shaw thermal partition + Komanduri shear-plane temp
units.scope: Thermal partition β as derived sidecar field with explicit (k_workpiece, k_tool, ρcp) traceability; shear-plane temp via Komanduri-Hou.
